name: BRAND TEXT
description:
TinnyBeautysauna suddenly broke down? Need some spare parts, but not sure where to find them? Stop looking! We have it all to help you get your infrared sauna back online! Friendly managers and top grade certified experts, authentic spare parts and fair prices – this is how we made infrared sauna repair as easy as possible!



TinnyBeautysauna knows how much effort it takes to make a perfect infrared sauna unit for people to enjoy at home. And that is why we make it our top priority to pay attention to details – every part and material is chosen solely to make it the best sauna you can ever find!
